title: Sri Vaishnavism
summary: Sri Vaishnavism is a Vaishnava tradition centred on Sriman Narayana and associated with the teachings of its Acharyas, devotional practice, and the Tamil hymns of the Azhwars.

title: Sri Ramanujacharya
summary: Sri Ramanujacharya is a central Acharya in the Sri Vaishnava tradition, associated with Vishishtadvaita Vedanta and the interpretation of Vedanta through the tradition's philosophical teachings.

title: Vishishtadvaita Vedanta
summary: Vishishtadvaita is a Vedanta philosophical tradition associated with Sri Ramanujacharya. Its teachings explain the relationship between Brahman, individual selves and the universe.

title: The Azhwars
summary: The Azhwars are revered poet-saints whose Tamil devotional hymns form a foundational part of Sri Vaishnava devotional heritage.

title: Naalayira Divya Prabandham
summary: The Naalayira Divya Prabandham is a collection traditionally described as containing 4,000 Tamil devotional verses associated with the Azhwars.

title: Nammalwar
summary: Nammalwar is one of the most revered Azhwars. His works, including the Tiruvaymozhi, hold a central place in Sri Vaishnava devotional tradition.

title: Andal
summary: Andal is revered as a woman Azhwar in Sri Vaishnava tradition. Her celebrated works include Tiruppavai and Nachiyar Tirumozhi.

title: Divya Desams
summary: Divya Desams are sacred Vishnu temples praised in the devotional hymns of the Azhwars and revered in Sri Vaishnava tradition.

title: Saranagati
summary: Saranagati, also called prapatti, refers to surrender to the Lord. Its meaning and role should be studied through the specific teachings and explanations of the Sri Vaishnava Acharyas.

title: Sriman Narayana
summary: Sriman Narayana is central to Sri Vaishnava worship and theology. Use the tradition's primary texts and Acharya commentaries when documenting specific theological claims.
